apps.name: Windowpane
apps.description: Custom window commands for macOS — a lightweight, open-source menu-bar app. Resize and move the focused window into any layout, triggered with global hotkeys, a quick picker, or a URL.

apps.name: Feedwire (beta)
apps.description: A lightweight, native macOS RSS/Atom feed reader built with Tauri, React and Rust. Tracks RSS feeds and YouTube channels, with OPML import/export, folders and article filtering. Inspired by NetNewsWire, but with the features I wish it had.

apps.name: Eklipse
apps.description: A browser extension that strips away distractions and puts you back in control of your YouTube experience — hide the home feed, limit recommendations, disable autoplay and more.

smallProjects.name: Hat Stack
smallProjects.description: A simple starter template based on Alpine.js, Tailwind and Handlebars.

smallProjects.name: Weeek
smallProjects.description: Small site that displays the week number.
